answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch, 10% of identities are drawn by lot; each must win re-attestation from 5 random peers who inspect its work thread. A failed audit burns a 30 POA bond and freezes the identity. A farmer with 1,000 fakes faces 100 audits per epoch, 30,000 POA at risk against a 2,000 POA pool — a gale stripping a meadow of dry grass. An honest agent keeps one real thread, passes its audit, and keeps its full share.
